SELECT greenhouse_id, greenhouse_name, greenhouse_type, cover_type, medium_type, greenhouse_image_url FROM greenhouse WHERE member_id = #{memberId}
AND greenhouse_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{greenhouseName}, '%')
AND greenhouse_type LIKE CONCAT('%', #{greenhouseType}, '%')
AND cover_type LIKE CONCAT('%', #{coverType}, '%')
AND medium_type LIKE CONCAT('%', #{mediumType}, '%')
ORDER BY created_at DESC, greenhouse_id DESC

SELECT greenhouse_id, greenhouse_name, greenhouse_type, cover_type, building_count, side_height, width, length, registered_area, medium_type, greenhouse_image_url FROM greenhouse WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND greenhouse_id = #{greenhouseId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO greenhouse ( member_id, greenhouse_name, created_at, greenhouse_type, cover_type, building_count, side_height, width, length, registered_area, medium_type, greenhouse_image_url ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{greenhouseName}, NOW(), #{greenhouseType}, #{coverType}, #{buildingCount}, #{sideHeight}, #{width}, #{length}, #{registeredArea}, #{mediumType}, #{greenhouseImageUrl} )
mapper.update: UPDATE greenhouse SET greenhouse_name = #{greenhouseName}, greenhouse_type = #{greenhouseType}, cover_type = #{coverType}, building_count = #{buildingCount}, side_height = #{sideHeight}, width = #{width}, length = #{length}, registered_area = #{registeredArea}, medium_type = #{mediumType}, greenhouse_image_url = #{greenhouseImageUrl, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND greenhouse_id = #{greenhouseId}
